build_vrpModel: build a vehicle routing problem model with LSTM encoder, MLP policy, and value estimator networks
run_vrpModel_rewrite: run the rewrite method to sample and apply route improvement operations on a single VRP instance
run_vrpModel_batch_rewrite: run batch rewrite to apply route improvement operations across multiple VRP instances in parallel
run_vrpModel_forward: run the forward pass to iteratively optimize VRP routes using policy gradient and value estimation
review_vrpModel_init: review the vrpModel constructor to configure optimizer, embedding size, attention size, and network components
